names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιος Γέμελλος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 10. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученик Гемел.“ — with «Свети» (“saint”) and «мученик» (the `martyr` grade `types` keeps) left off, which leaves the bare forename; the heading offers nothing else, and the city is in the body. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.

death.note: **Two sources on one year, and this NARROWS a reign to a date; it was 361–363, «under Julian the Apostate», before this reading.** saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Γέμελλος έζησε στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Ιουλιανού του παραβάτη (361 - 363 μ.Χ.)» — the interval was that reign, which is as close to a year as the page's own prose came — and the Nicodemus passage the same page quotes adds «εν έτει τξα΄ [361]». The Охридски пролог за 10. децембар ст. ст. states it outright: „Зато би мучен и на крст распет 361. године.“ — for that he was tortured and crucified on the cross in 361. The Greek page's quoted authority and this book agree on the year, so the bounds close on it; the basis stays traditional, neither being a document.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Γέμελλος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It prints a short modern notice and then a long quotation from the Synaxaristes of Saint Nicodemus the Hagiorite, and the two do not tell the same torments: the notice has pointed wooden splinters driven under his nails, red-hot iron laid on him and iron barbed rods, while Nicodemus's account has a red-hot iron belt, a march behind the apostate to Edessa, nails driven into his head, a flaying, and a baptism he received only then, at the hands of a priest he met on the way. Both end in his crucifixion. The life written here follows the page's own short notice and names the second account as the page's quotation. Ancyra and the parish called Klimaxine are named, but the page gives no coordinate and none is proposed. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 23.12.2025 (10. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Гемел.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: «мученик» is the `martyr` held, and «честан грађанин», an honourable citizen, is no rank. `dates` NARROWED, WHICH IS THE RARE DIRECTION: the folder held 361–363, the whole reign of Julian the Apostate, with the display «under Julian the Apostate», because that reign is as close to a year as saint.gr came in its own prose. THIS BOOK STATES THE YEAR — «Зато би мучен и на крст распет 361. године», for that he was tortured and crucified in 361 — and it agrees with the Nicodemus passage saint.gr quotes, «εν έτει τξα΄ [361]», which was already in the folder’s own note without being made the finding. Two sources on one year, so the interval closes on 361. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: that he was a citizen of ANKYRA; that when Julian the Apostate came to that city he went out before him and PUBLICLY CONVICTED HIM OF APOSTASY, which is why he suffered; and that while he hung in his torments on the cross a voice was heard from heaven, «Блажен си ти, Гемеле!», blessed are you, Gemellus. NO `locations`: Ankyra is the one place he is given and the folder has never held a coordinate. NO `related` ROW ADDED: `nicodemus-the-hagiorite` is already here, being the writer saint.gr quotes for him, and this entry names only the emperor, who is no folder. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
